readme.value: Greenhub/data source CSVs plus selected process/economic code; historical Greenhub/results/run outputs excluded to avoid stale duplicate inventories.
Rows preserve available values, units, cost years, currencies, scaling exponents and source files. Blank costs mean not found in source, not zero.
Global audit records unresolved cost overlaps; cost records should not be aggregated until ownership/boundaries are resolved.
